## Module evaluation

::: {.callout-tip}
## Please complete the evaluation
Goldsmiths runs **module evaluations** each term. Your honest feedback (what worked, what didn’t) is **anonymous** and directly shapes how we teach next year.

- Check **Learn.gold** for the link and deadline (often flagged in the module menu or announcements).
- It only takes a few minutes — thank you if you’ve already done it.
:::
